needs_review: THE SCAFFOLDED TEST PATH WAS WRONG AND IS CHANGED HERE. The scaffold (and the vault entry integrationTypeRegistry.js `split.testEndpoint`) both call https://api.split.io/internal/api/v2/splits?limit=1, and that path does not exist: probed 2026-09-12 it answers `404 {"code":404,"message":"HTTP 404 Not Found","details":null,"transactionId":""}` with a dummy bearer, while the workspace-scoped `/internal/api/v2/splits/ws/quoxprobe` answers `401 {"code":401,"message":"API key unauthorized: xxxxXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXTOKEN","details":null,"transactionId":"3wjyegshhws"}`. Admin API v2 scopes every flag read to a workspace, so `test` now calls `/internal/api/v2/workspaces` (probed `401 {"code":401,"message":"API key unauthorized: ...","transactionId":"3wjyditi5xm"}`), which is both provable and the read a real key must succeed at before any other tool is usable. The vault entry still carries the 404 path; fixing it is out of scope for this spec file and should be raised on the auth-side registry.

Auth kept as scaffolded (bearer on `api_key`) because the probe evidence supports it: every existing route answers 401 with Split's own structured envelope naming the presented key, which is a credential rejection and not a routing failure.

Split routes BEFORE it authenticates, which is what makes this spec blind-provable at path level: real paths answer 401 JSON, absent paths answer 404, and the harness control path (`https://api.split.io/quox-shapeproof-control-<hash>`) answers a Jetty HTML `404 Not Found` page. Three candidate reads were dropped for answering 404 under the same dummy key: `/internal/api/v2/tags/ws/{ws}`, `/internal/api/v2/largeSegments/ws/{ws}/{env}` and `/internal/api/v2/flagSets/ws/{ws}`.

Response picks are documentation-derived, not data-verified: no Split account was held, so no tool has ever seen a 2xx body. The list wrappers follow the Admin API reference (`objects` + `offset`/`limit`/`totalCount` for workspaces, splits and segments; a bare top-level array for environments and trafficTypes, picked with the v1.1 root-array form). If a wrapper name is wrong the tool returns an empty array rather than an error, so confirm each list tool against a real key before promoting this draft.

`limit` clamps at 50 because that is the documented Admin API maximum for list endpoints; spec v1 has one request per tool, so there is no auto-pagination and `offset` is exposed for the caller to page manually.

Documented filters (tag filtering on the flag list, status filtering on segments) are deliberately absent: their query-parameter names could not be confirmed without a key, and an unrecognised parameter on Split is silently ignored rather than rejected, which would make a filtered read look like a filtered read while returning everything.

User, group and change-request reads (`/internal/api/v2/users`, `/internal/api/v2/groups`, `/internal/api/v2/changeRequests`, all probed 401 so all present) are deliberately NOT included: their response wrapper differs from the `objects` family and could not be pinned down blind, and a wrong wrapper on a governance read would report 'no pending change requests' when there are some. Add them once a real key can confirm the shape.

Every tool is a GET marked `write: false`. The Admin API's write surface (create, update, kill, environment promotion) is reachable on these same paths with other verbs and is out of scope for this spec.

Split echoes a masked rendering of the presented key back in its 401 message, so proof bodies for this connector always contain a mangled form of the dummy credential. That is the vendor's error text, not a leak of a real secret, but it means a proof run made with a REAL key would put a partial key into the proof artifact. Only ever shape-proof this spec with the harness dummy.
